health.title: 久坐一小时，起来动 5 分钟
health.body: 肩颈僵硬的朋友，可以双手在背后交握，慢慢向上抬，停 10 秒，做 3 次。想有人带着练，可以去「健康」板块看看 Meet Yoga 小班瑜伽。

outings.title: Powerhouse Parramatta 开幕节
outings.when: 11 月 7–29 日，周末开到晚上 9 点
outings.price: 大部分活动免费，16 岁以下看展免费
outings.note: 新馆开幕，适合全家去逛。

grace_rock.title: 今天：蓝花楹下 · 心聚同行
grace_rock.body: 10:30–15:30，静心学堂春日户外团建在 Parramatta Park。看完 Powerhouse 正好顺路！

ai_tip.title: 让 AI 帮你写生日祝福
ai_tip.body: 告诉它对方是谁、你们的关系、一件难忘的小事，写出来会比模板走心很多。

health.title: Sat for an hour? Move for 5 minutes
health.body: For a stiff neck and shoulders, clasp your hands behind your back, lift them slowly, hold for 10 seconds, and repeat 3 times. Want a teacher? See Meet Yoga in the Health section.

outings.title: Powerhouse Parramatta Opening Festival
outings.price: Most events free; exhibitions free for under-16s
outings.note: A brand-new museum, great for the whole family.

grace_rock.title: Today: Under the Jacarandas
grace_rock.body: The 静心学堂 spring outdoor day is at Parramatta Park, 10:30am–3:30pm. It's right near the Powerhouse!

ai_tip.title: Let AI help with a birthday message
ai_tip.body: Tell it who the person is, how you know them, and one small memory. The result feels far more personal than a template.
